assets.prompt: Use the supplied animal images as style references for an original single character sprite for a cozy cartoon animal merging game. Create one sweet round compact brown bear, with little round ears, a light cream muzzle and friendly expressive face. Match their front-facing view, warm dark brown outline, muted natural colors, upper-left soft lighting and gentle shading. Keep the complete body and small ears compact near a circular silhouette; center it in a square canvas with generous margins and no cropping. Isolated on transparent background if supported, no text, no logo, no scenery or shadows on the ground. Do not copy any existing character.
